subjects.subject: Zel / Emperor Zel
subjects.artifact: Compact profile in existing coverage audit
subjects.basis: A named nonhuman agent with directly narrated resistance to handling,approach to Vanir,quiet holding,pecks,startle-linked reaction,curling/sleep,proximity to Chomusuke,later crowing and growth. These actions and changing care relationships deserve individual treatment.
subjects.Tier2_alternative: The longitudinal development story is substantial in its effects on the household. However,much explanatory variety consists of other people’s purchase,training,dragon and combat projections. The bird’s discriminating behavior remains a small set of locally observed ordinary responses plus mediated reports; a substantial independently motivated interpretation would mostly repeat these or populate dimensions with unsupported human intentions.
subjects.Tier3_alternative: Warmth,early attachment,food-seeking,startle and ordinary chick/rooster behavior remain serious generic rivals. Imprinting is Kazuma’s explanation,not an isolated causal test. No differentiated falsifiable individual generator across changed incentives is identified.
subjects.limits: No permanent animal/secondary ceiling or requirement of verbal interiority. Stronger nonverbal choice evidence could support later depth. Handler dragon beliefs,decoded clucks and future battle promises do not substitute for it.

subjects.subject: Unnamed original dragon-egg seller
subjects.artifact: Separate compact reported-actor profile in existing coverage audit
subjects.basis: Aqua reports specific sales framing,chosen heroic-adventurer audience,dragon-familiar need,all-her-money price and working-caretaker justification at MAIN07U012P153/P162: a consequential attributed choice sequence.
subjects.Tier2_alternative: One retrospectively reported exchange supplies no own perspective,wider conduct or response to contrary conditions. A monograph would overextend this narrow source.
subjects.Tier3_alternative: Persuasion for profit is plausible; exact motive and knowledge remain unavailable. One mediated exchange does not identify a stable individual policy rather than ordinary sales framing.
subjects.limits: Keep Aqua’s report separate from Kazuma’s fraud/wealth inference. No name,verified knowing fraud,disjointness from later senders or identity with seed/weapon merchants is established.
